Maya (CS): quick heads up — Nia from Cosmos rolled to prod and their SDK init is getting a flurry of 429s on first deploy. attaching logs.
Nia (Cosmos): yea, we push a new service and on startup all pods call `Client.init()` at once. ~50 pods. first 2 minutes it's mostly 429s then recovers.
Raj (Eng): thanks — can you paste the init snippet and which SDK version?
Nia (Cosmos): using node-sdk v1.8.2
Nia (Cosmos): code:
```js
const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await c.init({ env: 'prod', maxConcurrency: 20 });
```
Alex (SRE): logs:
```
2026-03-22T14:45:02Z ERROR 429 /v1/init client=10.0.2.5 pod=cosmos-1
2026-03-22T14:45:03Z ERROR 429 /v1/init client=10.0.2.6 pod=cosmos-2
```
Raj (Eng): yep classic init-fanout. Two quick mitigations: stagger startup (k8s preStop sleep or helm rollout hooks) and add client-side jitter + exponential backoff on init.
Maya (CS): do we have an SDK helper to backoff on init so customers don't have to roll custom logic?
Raj (Eng): we have `initWithRetry()` in recent SDKs (>=1.8.0) but it's opt-in. Example:
```js
await c.initWithRetry({ maxAttempts: 8, baseDelayMs: 200, jitter: true });
```
Raj (Eng): also suggest `maxConcurrency` lower during warmup, e.g., set to 2-4 for first minute then increase after healthy probe.
Nia (Cosmos): ok will try switching to initWithRetry + small concurrency cap. any tip for token refresh/ephemeral keys?
Alex (SRE): If you're using ephemeral tokens, splay refresh across instances. Avoid simultaneous prefetch.
Maya (CS): I'll send a short runbook and link to docs: https://docs.redwood.inference/sdk/init-best-practices
Maya (CS): action items: Nia to test initWithRetry + start-stagger; Raj to provide sample helm init hook; Maya to schedule 30m enablement if needed.
Nia (Cosmos): testing now, report back in ~15m :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: rollout/cosmos-stable started by Nia — watch: https://k8s.console/rollouts/12345
Raj (Eng): if issue persists ping me, we can enable temporary ratebackoff rule on their account for the ramp.
Maya (CS): thanks all — keeping this thread open until stable :white_check_mark:
